name: app-store-screenshots-in-frosted-glass-with-pearl-blue-gradients
title: Six frosted-glass store screenshots: #1 laurel, home, send money, earning, utility payments and controls
whatItIs: A row of tall rounded screenshot cards on white with pearl blue gradients, each with a light two-line headline and small subline over a phone or UI fragment: a #1 laurel and a hand with a card, a home screen, a send-money keypad, a hand-held earning screen with a donut chart card, a bill reminder toggle card and a partial controls view.
whatItMeans: Airy and reassuring; frosted cards and hands make each feature feel tangible.
techniques: Give each screenshot a frosted card and short headline.
Mix full phones with cropped UI fragments.

vocabulary.definition: A rounded card holding one store image.
A cropped piece of interface as illustration.
A wreath around a rank or rating.
A settings switch shown as a feature.
